recipes.title: Sophie's Spinach and Artichoke Dip

ingredients.notes: thawed and pressed dry; do not use fresh spinach, it will not wilt in this preparation
drained/rinsed, hand rough-chopped into larger chunks; use quartered not pre-chopped hearts; this ~22oz combo is untested, confirm before treating as final
reduced from original 3/4 tbsp, which was too salty
divided: 1 cup for filling, 1 cup for topping
divided: 1 cup for filling, 1/2 cup for topping

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).

In a large bowl, combine cream cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, spinach, artichoke hearts, garlic salt, onion powder, 1 cup mozzarella, and 1 cup Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix until well combined.
Transfer to an oven-safe baking dish. Top with remaining 1 cup mozzarella and 1/2 cup Parmesan.
Bake 25-30 minutes, until melted and browning.
Serve hot with chips or vegetables.
open_questions: Confirm the 14 oz can + 8 oz jar (~22 oz) artichoke quantity on next test batch.

recipes.title: Beef Birria Tacos
recipes.notes: His real go-to recipe, used with great success. An earlier Week of Aug 2 recipe was NOT this one and did not work out.

ingredients.item: beef chuck roast, cut into 3-inch chunks

instructions: Deseed and rinse chiles, simmer in water 15 minutes until softened.
Broil tomatoes, onion, and garlic on a sheet pan 4-6 minutes until lightly charred.
Blend chiles with 1 cup of their cooking water, the charred tomato/onion/garlic, broth, vinegar, cumin, oregano, cloves, cinnamon, and ginger until smooth.
Put beef chunks in slow cooker, pour sauce over, add bay leaves, mix, cover.
Cook low 8-9 hrs or high 4-5 hrs until fall-apart tender.
Discard bay leaves, shred beef, reserve 1-2 cups of the fattiest top-layer liquid (consommé), return shredded beef to cooker to absorb remaining liquid.

For tacos: dip (don't dunk) tortillas in the reserved fatty consommé, fry in a hot skillet, flip, sprinkle cheese across the whole tortilla, add beef + onion + cilantro to half, fold once cheese melts, fry 2-3 minutes per side until crispy.
Serve with consommé for dipping.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Pork Tenderloin
recipes.notes: A hit. Leftovers repurposed into tacos.
instructions: Whisk garlic, orange juice, lime juice, oregano, cumin, olive oil, salt, and pepper together. Add pork, marinate at least 30 min (up to overnight, refrigerated).
Remove pork from marinade (discard marinade). Sear in a hot oven-safe skillet, 2-3 min per side, until browned.
Roast at 400°F until internal temp hits 145°F, about 15-20 min. Rest 5 min, slice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Barbacoa

ingredients.item: beef chuck roast, cut into 3-4 large chunks

instructions: Add all ingredients to the Instant Pot.
Seal and cook on high pressure 45 min, natural release 15 min.
Shred beef, stir back into cooking liquid, adjust salt to taste.

recipes.title: Chayote-Lime Slaw
recipes.notes: Served alongside the Instant Pot Beef Barbacoa. A hit; he added avocado to it. Red onion, jalapeño, and pineapple were discussed as possible additions but not yet confirmed as tried.

ingredients.item: chayote squash, peeled, seeded, and julienned

ingredients.notes: added at cook time, worked well

instructions: Toss chayote, lime juice, cilantro, olive oil, and salt together in a bowl.
Fold in diced avocado just before serving.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Tortilla Roll-Ups
recipes.notes: Good, but recipe as originally written made way too much (34 rolls, almost half the meat mixture left over - scale down next time). 93% lean beef overcooked at original bake time; better at 18 min at 420°F plus ~5 more minutes to melt the cheese well.
instructions: Preheat oven. Combine beef, onion, bell pepper, parsley, 1 cup mozzarella, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika.
Divide filling among tortillas, spread thin and even to the edges, roll tightly, slice into ~2.5" rounds.
Arrange cut-side up in a baking dish, brush with olive oil.
Bake 18 minutes at 420°F, top with remaining mozzarella, bake ~5 more minutes until melted.
Whisk together ketchup, mayo, and garlic powder for the dip; serve alongside.
open_questions: Original quantities made 34 rolls with ~half the meat mixture unused — needs a scaled-down version tested before fully locked in.

recipes.title: Esquites-Style Street Corn Salad
recipes.notes: His go-to version, a hit. Add a diced jalapeño to the skillet along with the corn (he normally includes it but forgot this time).

ingredients.notes: fresh off the cob, or frozen

instructions: In a dry skillet over medium-high heat, cook corn and diced jalapeño together, without stirring for 2-3 min stretches, until charred in spots, 8-10 min total.
Transfer to a bowl, stir in mayo, cotija, lime juice, and chili powder.
Top with cilantro, serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Smoky Semi-Charro Black Beans
recipes.notes: A hit, "tastes awesome," strong Book contender.

ingredients.notes: plus more as needed; a full cup was too much, 1/2 cup plus more while reducing was right
from his copper hand-crank mill, once dialed in

instructions: Dice bacon, onion, jalapeño, tomato and mince garlic.
Combine beans (undrained), bacon, onion, jalapeño, tomato, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne.
Add 1/2 cup chicken stock, adding more as needed while reducing.
Season with salt and ~40 turns of black pepper.
Cook, reducing to desired consistency.

recipes.title: Mexican Street Corn (Elote)
recipes.notes: Sister recipe to the Esquites version — on-the-cob presentation vs. off-the-cob salad.
instructions: Grill corn directly over a gas burner or grill pan, turning frequently, until charred in spots all around, ~8-10 min. (For frozen kernels: char in a dry cast iron skillet over high heat without stirring until colored.)
Brush/slather each ear with mayo while still hot.
Hit with lime, shower with cotija and chili powder.
Serve immediately — does not hold well.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage & White Bean Skillet
recipes.notes: Very good, a Book entry. Basil was cut entirely — felt it would be overload.
instructions: Brown sausage in a large skillet, 5-6 min.
Add shallot, cook 1 min, then garlic, cook 30 sec.
Add beans, tomatoes, and stock. Simmer uncovered 10 min.
Stir in parsley off heat.
